item.title: Banned outlets sue Trump; TV networks pull White House pool in solidarity
item.description: The dispute centers on long-standing legal and practical arrangements governing press access to the White House, including the multi-decade-old television 'pool' system that outlets like CNN, ABC, CBS, NBC and Fox use to share the cost and logistics of covering presidential events.
